Agenda Item No 6 General Written Public Comments

The Tahoe Regional Planning Agency (TRPA) appreciates and considers all input from the public. Public comments are welcome by virtual and in-person attendees at the beginning and end of every meeting. Written comments are equally welcome by email to [email protected] and by mail or fax.

Comments are posted here and distributed to the Advisory Planning Commission and the appropriate staff through 3:00 p.m. the day before the scheduled meeting. To ensure appropriate distribution and posting, include the meeting information and agenda item in the subject line.

The agency encourages commenters to submit written comments well in advance of the meeting date to allow enough time to post and distribute them. Written comments are updated periodically as they are received through 3:00 p.m. the day before a scheduled meeting. Staff will continue to upload and distribute written comments through 5:00 p.m. Additionally, late comments may be distributed and posted after the meeting.

Public comments uploaded here are listed with the most recent comments first at the time they are received. To view the most up to date public comment documents, it may be necessary to clear your web browser cache.
